dataQuality.note: Unusable snapshots are excluded: those whose stored American price is not a valid American odd (|price| < 100, a decimal coefficient written to an integer column), those with no market label (a market key outside the stored set, silently blanked on write), those with no book (a book outside an older stored set, blanked on write until late March 2026), placeholder prices (a Novig spread or total at -9900 or shorter, or a price clipped at 32767 / -32768 by an older column type), and spreads or totals whose line is known to be wrong for one book and period (BetMGM NFL and NCAAF spreads and totals before 2026-09-25 22:15 UTC, Novig NFL and NCAAF spreads before 2026-09-20 20:40 UTC, Hard Rock spreads of 40 or more points outside NCAAF before 2026-09-26 01:30 UTC), plus every Circa row from 2026-04-03 to 2026-08-24, which may hold another sportsbook's prices. None of these is recoverable for the affected rows.
dataQuality.mainLineNote: Each row is the book main line for that market and side: one line per book, market and side. Alternate rungs and team totals are not stored; a period market (first_half_h2h, first_half_spreads, first_half_totals) is stored under its own key, never under totals or spreads. Older rows, recorded before the one-line rule was enforced at capture, and rows from the pinnacle_mqtt source can carry such lines under totals or spreads for some books. inPlay, where present, says whether the game was in play when the row was captured; commenceTime on /history/games, where present, lets recordedAtUtc be cut to pre-game rows; it is absent for games archived before it began to be recorded.
